description: This Java source file defines the MainActivityFragment class for an Android application. It manages a fragment that displays a list of files, handles user interactions such as adding files, and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivityFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing a list of files, with options to add files and update the list, used as part of an Android app's UI.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes the fragment.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the AddFileActivity, updating the file list if a new file was added.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks, including starting the AddFileActivity.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the adapter for the list of files when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: createListOfFiles
methods.description: Creates a list of file objects from internal and external directories.

methods.name: addFilesToList
methods.description: Adds files from a directory to the list.

methods.name: updateListOfFiles
methods.description: Refreshes the displayed list of files and updates UI elements based on file availability.
